text: {"lessons":["Selling winners in several small rounds can realize gains, but I should avoid trimming solely because a stock has risen; consider its prospects and my target allocation.","My account value fell after the early gains, so a few successful sales do not guarantee steady overall growth; review the whole portfolio and its risks.","I tend to sell stocks that rise and hold those that fall, so I should check losing positions objectively rather than letting loss aversion dictate my decisions."]}
